answer.thought: The headline of the vaccine reaching eighty percent of girls strikes me as a fact of civil society's administrative power, a universal measure imposed from above. It is a mechanism of the state, yet it feels detached from the spiritual life of the individual, a mere statistic of health. I note the Calcutta case with interest; the High Court acting in criminal contempt is the state asserting its ethical unity against the particular will of a politician. I will sit on the step and read the papers, letting the morning air sharpen my mind before I move.
